# human { #crossrepo.cli.human }

```python
crossrepo.cli.human(n)
```

Format a byte count for display.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**n**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Number of bytes. A negative number means the size is unknown.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A short string such as ``948B`` or ``488.5M``, or ``?`` when unknown.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
human(512189753)
# '488.5M'
```
